speaker: Doctor
text: I'm Dr. Agent. You're here because of weakness and fatigue; have you experienced any fever, weight loss, or night sweats recently? How would you describe the onset of these symptoms—sudden or gradual?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history; given your recent hiking and camping, have you noticed any mosquito or tick bites, or any skin rashes on your body? Also, have you experienced muscle pain, joint aches, or any visual changes like blurred vision or double vision?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. Given the classic triad of fatigue, diplopia, and recent travel history which could suggest an overlap or trigger, I am requesting images of the chest to rule out thymoma as an underlying cause.
